name: Seltz
tagline: Source-backed web search, news, company and people lookups, and page fetch
description: Seltz's hosted MCP server gives Cline source-backed results from the public web: general search, news, company profiles, public people profiles, SEC financial reports, and Wikipedia. When you already have a URL, it fetches the page as Markdown. Sign in through the Seltz Console with OAuth; new accounts receive free request credit.
